title: Find your rhythm
description: Rounded intensity cells reveal daily patterns against a fixed scale.

props.name: data
props.description: { rowId, columnId, value } readings. Pairs must be unique and reference declared axes. Missing, non-finite, negative or above-maximum readings show a cross; zero shows a dot. Every declared cell remains inspectable even when all readings are missing.

props.name: rows
props.description: Caller-ordered { id, label } rows with unique nonempty IDs.

props.name: columns
props.description: Caller-ordered { id, label } columns with unique nonempty IDs.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Fixed finite positive intensity ceiling. Values never normalize to the current dataset maximum.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement label; defaults to Value (Total for SoftDonut).

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats direct values and tooltips; defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimals.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and long keys scroll locally.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
